carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature is observed on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-contrast pattern of high-luminance blobs, with the largest and most intense pixel clusters localized toward the distal and posterior edges of the fin silhouette.
